## Abstract

The learning session will focus on the general operations of the Office of Student Conduct.  The presenter will discuss the key procedures associated with academic misconduct cases, including proper adjudication techniques for faculty and how to properly report cases to OSC.  The presenter will also provide best practices for promoting academic integrity in courses and how to confront possible violations of the Code of Student Conduct.
